title: Throw It
author: Claude
blurb: Two short levels about throwing a star. Press Enter and Mia tosses one the way they last walked: it pops a mint green gumdrop sitting still, falls short if you stand too far away, and clears a grump out of a narrow way. Signs in the levels say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change the star.

box.back: A small explorer in a purple beanie has a pocketful of gold stars and two short levels to cross. A mint green gumdrop sits still, waiting to be popped, and a grump fills a narrow way through a brick wall. Read the signs, press Enter, then open the game in Game-Maker and change the star.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
A star flies the way you last walked, and only so far
Made to be copied and taken apart
